title: Yam nuea (Thai beef salad)
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Sear the steak in a very hot pan for 2–3 minutes per side, rest it for 5 minutes and slice thinly.
Stir the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and finely chopped chilli together.
Halve the tomatoes, slice the cucumber and onion and toss with lettuce, herbs, beef and dressing; serve with rice.
